title: Add checklist progress API (state read + internal event ingest) for onboarding checklist MVP
author: Jada Williams
description: Context: We’re adding an in-console onboarding checklist (“first production launch”) and need a stable backend contract for (a) fetching the current checklist state for a workspace/tenant and (b) ingesting server-side onboarding events emitted by gateway/control plane. This PR introduces a small checklist progress API service surface (behind internal auth) plus basic unit tests. Scope: - Read API for Console: GET checklist state + computed completion (per-step state, timestamps, completion percent, and next recommended step). - Write-only internal ingestion API: POST onboarding events (server-to-server only) with idempotency keys; persists raw events and updates step state. - Computation: event-driven completion with monotonic transitions (never regress a step from COMPLETE->INCOMPLETE) and deterministic ordering by event_time + ingest_time fallback. - Security/privacy: payload is restricted to schema v1 (no PII fields); request auth is mTLS + internal service token; write endpoint not exposed to public clients. Non-goals (for this PR): admin override/reset endpoints (tracked separately), backfill job, UI. API sketch: - GET /v1/onboarding/checklist/progress?tenant_id=... -> { steps: [...], percent_complete, completed_at?, last_event_at } - POST /internal/v1/onboarding/events (write-only) -> 202 Accepted Example event body: { "schema_version":"1.0", "event_name":"onboarding.first_successful_request", "tenant_id":"tnt_...", "occurred_at":"2025-03-03T21:14:02Z", "idempotency_key":"gw:req_9f..." } Testing: adds unit tests for step transition logic (idempotency, out-of-order arrival, double-ingest, unknown event handling) and API auth gating. Rollout: endpoints are behind feature flag ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST_PROGRESS_API (off by default); Console will call the read endpoint once UI ships. Notes: event names and required fields align with onboarding-event-schema-v1 (Confluence); any schema changes should bump schema_version and be backward compatible for at least 30 days.

review_conversation: Chloe Martin: Can we make step completion monotonic by design? I’m worried about out-of-order events when gateway retries. Also please confirm we’re not using request_id alone as an idempotency key (could collide cross-region).

Jada Williams (author): Updated compute module to enforce monotonic transitions. For idempotency_key, we now require producers to prefix by source and include a stable unique token (e.g., gw:req_<uuid> or cp:apikey_<id>). Added a unit test for cross-source collisions.

Logan Wright: The GET response currently includes `last_event_payload` for debugging. That feels risky from a privacy perspective and also increases payload size. Can we remove it and rely on internal logging instead?

Jada Williams (author): Removed last_event_payload from the public (Console) read response. Internal logs capture event_name + ids with sampling. Keeping raw payload only in onboarding_events table (restricted access).
Ethan Park: For multi-tenant access control: GET should only allow Console service principals to query tenant_id they are scoped for. Where is scoping enforced?
Jada Williams (author): Added `requireConsoleTenantScope()` middleware which checks the service token claims for allowed tenant_ids (or org_id wildcard for Console). Tests included in routes.test.ts.
Marcus Lin: Please document retention expectations and confirm no user-supplied text is included. Also ensure `occurred_at` is validated (no future timestamps > 24h).

Jada Williams (author): Added validation for occurred_at (reject >24h future). Added README section: payload fields are fixed schema, no prompts/completions/user content. Retention will follow telemetry defaults (separate review), but DB table is marked as ‘internal telemetry’ classification.
Dylan Brooks: Can you add a ‘next_step’ field so the UI doesn’t need to re-implement ordering logic?
Jada Williams (author): Added `next_recommended_step_id` derived from first INCOMPLETE step in canonical ordering. UI can still override ordering later if needed.
Chloe Martin: Approved once the OpenAPI spec matches the actual response shape (I saw a mismatch on `percent_complete` naming).
Jada Williams (author): Synced OpenAPI to `percent_complete` + added schema tests. Pushed fix.
Marcus Lin: Approved with note to follow up on retention doc in security review ticket.
release_notes: Internal: Introduces onboarding checklist progress API (read state + internal event ingestion) behind feature flag; no end-user visible changes until Console UI is enabled.
